name: Plex Photos
description: Photo-frame screensaver that pulls images straight from a Plex Media Server photo library, so you do not need Immich. Turn on Sign in with Plex, then choose Plex Photos under Screensaver > Screensaver mode.
author: Josh Dollow

settings.title: Sign in with Plex
settings.description: Shows a code to enter at plex.tv/link on your phone or computer. Switches itself off when sign-in finishes. Sign in as the Plex user whose photos this kiosk should show.

settings.title: Server address
settings.description: Leave blank to find your server automatically when you sign in. Or enter its address, for example https://192-168-1-20.<id>.plex.direct:32400 or http://192.168.1.20:32400.

settings.title: Plex token (encrypted)
settings.description: Filled in by Sign in with Plex and stored encrypted with a key that never leaves this kiosk. You can also paste a token here; it is encrypted when saved.

settings.title: Accept self-signed HTTPS
settings.description: Only needed for an https:// address whose certificate does not match, such as https://<LAN IP>:32400. The server's certificate is pinned: the first one seen is remembered below, and any other certificate is refused.

settings.title: Server certificate fingerprint
settings.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the Plex server certificate, used with Accept self-signed HTTPS. Filled in automatically on first connection. Clear it to trust a new certificate.

settings.title: Device ID
settings.description: Identifies this kiosk to Plex, so each kiosk appears separately under Authorized Devices. Filled in automatically. Leave it alone.

settings.title: Photo libraries
settings.description: Comma-separated library names. Leave blank to use every photo library on the server.

settings.title: Albums
settings.description: Comma-separated album names, including sub-albums. Leave blank for the whole library.

settings.title: Taken within
settings.description: Date filter on the photo's taken date. On this day matches the same date, plus or minus three days, in any year.

settings.title: Shuffle
settings.description: Off plays photos in date order.

settings.title: Refresh photo list (hours)
settings.description: How often the photo list is re-read from Plex while the screensaver runs.

settings.title: Fill the screen
settings.description: Smart crops only photos already close to the screen's shape. Others sit over a blurred copy of themselves.

settings.title: Info corner
settings.description: Pick a corner your KS widgets and clock do not use.

settings.title: Maximum image size (px)
settings.description: Long-edge cap for images requested from Plex. Capped again at the screen's own resolution.
